excluded_from_active_unlisted_queue.rule: Do not carry an item as unlisted after its canonical promotion has landed.
Track as deployment/history work for the existing canonical asset, not as a new stable-asset candidate.
Do not create a second canonical asset; preserve only lineage/history work when relevant.
